verdict.rationale: Gitleaks' CLI is explicitly headless and scriptable, supporting JSON report output and CI-style exit codes for gating (gitleaks-probe-4, gitleaks-gh-13), which lets an agent run scans and parse machine-readable results. However, 'filing issues for real findings' is only indirectly supported via gitleaks-action posting PR comments/alerts (gitleaks-docs-2, gitleaks-docs-3), not a documented issue-creation API or agent-oriented workflow. Missing for 10: explicit support for filing GitHub/Jira issues programmatically, agent-specific tooling or examples, and independent confirmation of the PR-comment flow beyond first-party docs.
